name: Cyclist Bryony

intro.text: Ditchling Beacon! The meanest hill on the London to Brighton ride. Thirty thousand of us do it every summer, and about twenty-nine thousand of us push the bike up the last bit.

win: Fair enough. My legs had already lost before you turned up.
after: It's 54 miles from London to Brighton. All the way you think: nearly there. Then the Beacon.
